title: Evaluation, Metrics and Test Sets
introduction: An AI system should be judged with representative examples and metrics connected to its real purpose.
learningOutcomes: Separate training, validation and test data.
Recognise distribution shift and subgroup evaluation.

activities.question: Which data should provide the final unbiased evaluation?
options: Data copied from the model output
activities.explanation: A held-out test set estimates behaviour on examples not used to fit or tune the model.

activities.question: High overall accuracy guarantees equally good results for every subgroup.
activities.explanation: Aggregate performance can hide serious errors for smaller or differently represented groups.

activities.question: The proportion of flagged cases that are actually positive is ___.
activities.explanation: Precision asks how many positive predictions were correct.
